nuggets.text: The HTTP 400 error is due to the method of setting the request body in Laravel's HTTP client.
Pass the JSON data directly as an associative array in the method call instead of using `withBody`.
Laravel's HTTP client automatically uses the `application/json` content type when data is passed as an associative array.
